title: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact · 要点精讲(第2轮)
summary: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would have + past participle.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。
points: if + had + past participle
main clause would/could have + past participle
expresses regret or hypothesis about the past
if omitted, invert: Had I known...
mixed with a present result: the main clause is still would + base verb

examples.en: If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
examples.zh: 如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。

examples.en: If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train.
examples.zh: 如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。

examples.en: If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
examples.zh: 如果我们带了地图,就不会迷路了。

examples.en: If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
examples.zh: 如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。

examples.en: Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
examples.zh: 要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。

examples.en: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
examples.zh: 如果没下雨,我们就出去了。

questions.prompt: 「如果我知道真相,我早就告诉你了。」的正确英文是?
options: If I knew the truth, I would have told you.
If I have known the truth, I would have told you.
If I would know the truth, I would have told you.
If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If I had known the truth, I would have told you.

questions.prompt: If he had left earlier, he _____ the train.
options: had caught
will have caught
would have caught
would catch
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 would have caught。句意:如果他早点出发,就赶上火车了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If we had taken a map, we hadn't got lost.
If we had taken a map, we wouldn't get lost.
If we had taken a map, we won't get lost.
If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.
questions.explanation: If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If we had taken a map, we wouldn't have got lost.

questions.prompt: 「如果她更努力学习,就能通过了。」的正确英文是?
options: If she had studied harder, she could have passed.
If she had studied harder, she could pass.
If she had studied harder, she had passed.
If she had studied harder, she can have passed.
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If she had studied harder, she could have passed.

questions.prompt: _____ you, I would have said hello.
options: If I would see
Had I seen
Did I see
Have I seen
questions.explanation: 考查If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。此处应为 Had I seen。句意:要是我看见了你,我会打招呼的。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If it wouldn't rain, we would have gone out.
If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
If it didn't rain, we would have gone out.
If it hasn't rained, we would have gone out.
questions.explanation: If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。正确句:If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.

title: Subjunctive mood after wish · 要点精讲(第2轮)
summary: The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。
points: wish + subject + past (a present wish)
wish + subject + past perfect (a past regret)
wish + could/would + base verb (a future wish)
were is used for all persons
if only = how I wish

examples.en: I wish I had more free time.
examples.zh: 真希望我有更多空闲时间。

examples.en: She wishes she had studied harder before.
examples.zh: 她真希望以前更努力学习。

examples.en: I wish I were as tall as my brother.
examples.zh: 真希望我和哥哥一样高。

examples.en: He wishes he could fly a plane.
examples.zh: 他真希望自己会开飞机。

examples.en: If only I had taken your advice!
examples.zh: 要是我听了你的建议就好了!

examples.en: We wish we had visited Sydney last year.
examples.zh: 真希望我们去年去了悉尼。

questions.prompt: I wish I _____ more free time.
options: have
had
would have
having
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 had。句意:真希望我有更多空闲时间。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She wishes she would study harder before.
She wishes she had studied harder before.
She wishes she has studied harder before.
She wishes she studied harder before.
questions.explanation: wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:She wishes she had studied harder before.

questions.prompt: 「真希望我和哥哥一样高。」的正确英文是?
options: I wish I was as tall as my brother.
I wish I were as tall as my brother.
I wish I am as tall as my brother.
I wish I will be as tall as my brother.
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:I wish I were as tall as my brother.

questions.prompt: He wishes he _____ a plane.
options: can fly
flew
could fly
could flew
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。此处应为 could fly。句意:他真希望自己会开飞机。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If only I took your advice!
If only I would take your advice!
If only I have taken your advice!
If only I had taken your advice!
questions.explanation: wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:If only I had taken your advice!

questions.prompt: 「真希望我们去年去了悉尼。」的正确英文是?
options: We wish we had visited Sydney last year.
We wish we visited Sydney last year.
We wish we have visited Sydney last year.
We wish we would visit Sydney last year.
questions.explanation: 考查wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。正确句:We wish we had visited Sydney last year.

title: Subjunctive mood after suggest / insist · 要点精讲(第2轮)
summary: After suggest, insist, demand, order, the object clause uses (should) + base verb.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。
points: suggest/insist/demand/order + (should) + base verb
should can be omitted
the negative is (should) not + base verb
the corresponding noun/adjective also take the base form
insist on 'insisting on a fact' takes the normal tense

examples.en: The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
examples.zh: 医生建议他多锻炼。

examples.en: She insisted that we be there on time.
examples.zh: 她坚持要我们准时到。

examples.en: The teacher demanded that the homework be handed in today.
examples.zh: 老师要求今天交作业。

examples.en: It is important that everyone follow the rules.
examples.zh: 每个人都遵守规则很重要。

examples.en: He ordered that the work be finished at once.
examples.zh: 他命令立刻完成工作。

examples.en: My mother suggested that I not watch too much TV.
examples.zh: 我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The doctor suggested that he took more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he takes more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.
The doctor suggested that he taking more exercise.
questions.explanation: Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:The doctor suggested that he take more exercise.

questions.prompt: 「她坚持要我们准时到。」的正确英文是?
options: She insisted that we are there on time.
She insisted that we be there on time.
She insisted that we were there on time.
She insisted that we being there on time.
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:She insisted that we be there on time.

questions.prompt: The teacher demanded that the homework _____ in today.
options: be handed
was handed
is handed
been handed
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 be handed。句意:老师要求今天交作业。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: It is important that everyone followed the rules.
It is important that everyone following the rules.
It is important that everyone follows the rules.
It is important that everyone follow the rules.
questions.explanation: Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:It is important that everyone follow the rules.

questions.prompt: 「他命令立刻完成工作。」的正确英文是?
options: He ordered that the work be finished at once.
He ordered that the work been finished at once.
He ordered that the work is finished at once.
He ordered that the work was finished at once.
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。正确句:He ordered that the work be finished at once.

questions.prompt: My mother suggested that I _____ too much TV.
options: not to watch
not watching
didn't watch
not watch
questions.explanation: 考查Verbs of suggestion, demand, and order + (should) + base verb。此处应为 not watch。句意:我妈妈建议我不要看太多电视。

title: Mixed subjunctive moods · 要点精讲(第2轮)
summary: Mixed subjunctive moods: the time referenced by the if clause differs from the main clause; choose the tense separately.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。
points: past condition + present result
if + had done, main clause would do
present condition + past result is rare
judge the time by the context
were/was, had, should trigger inversion when if is omitted

examples.en: If I had taken that job, I would be in Chengdu now.
examples.zh: 如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在成都了。

examples.en: If he hadn't missed the bus, he would be here now.
examples.zh: 如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。

examples.en: If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
examples.zh: 如果我更聪明,昨天就把它解出来了。

examples.en: Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
examples.zh: 如果你那时问我,我现在也会帮你。

examples.en: If she had gone to bed early, she wouldn't be tired now.
examples.zh: 如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。

examples.en: If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
examples.zh: 如果我那时攒了钱,今天就能买了。

questions.prompt: 「如果我当时接受那份工作,我现在就在成都了。」的正确英文是?
options: If I had taken that job, I had been in Chengdu now.
If I had taken that job, I would have been in Chengdu now.
If I had taken that job, I will be in Chengdu now.
If I had taken that job, I would be in Chengdu now.
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I had taken that job, I would be in Chengdu now.

questions.prompt: If he _____ the bus, he would be here now.
options: hadn't missed
didn't miss
hasn't missed
wouldn't miss
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 hadn't missed。句意:如果他没错过公交车,他现在就在这里了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
If I was smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
If I had been smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
If I would be smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.
questions.explanation: A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I were smarter, I would have solved it yesterday.

questions.prompt: 「如果你那时问我,我现在也会帮你。」的正确英文是?
options: Did you ask me then, I would help you even now.
If you would ask me then, I would help you even now.
Have you asked me then, I would help you even now.
Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:Had you asked me then, I would help you even now.

questions.prompt: If she had gone to bed early, she _____ tired now.
options: wouldn't have been
hadn't been
wouldn't be
won't be
questions.explanation: 考查A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。此处应为 wouldn't be。句意:如果她早点睡,现在就不会累了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: If I had saved money then, I had bought it today.
If I had saved money then, I could have bought it today.
If I had saved money then, I can buy it today.
If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.
questions.explanation: A past condition with a present result: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would + base verb。正确句:If I had saved money then, I could buy it today.

title: Inversion with fronted negative words · 要点精讲(第2轮)
summary: Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。
points: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.
Not only did we lose, but we also got hurt.
Little did he know the truth.
the negative adverb determines the use of the auxiliary

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.zh: 我从未见过这么美的日落。

examples.en: Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
examples.zh: 我们刚出发就开始下雨了。

examples.en: Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
examples.zh: 他不仅工作努力,还很善良。

examples.en: Little did she know that the answer was wrong.
examples.zh: 她一点也不知道答案是错的。

examples.en: Not once has he been late this year.
examples.zh: 今年他一次也没迟到过。

examples.en: Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
examples.zh: 我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。

questions.prompt: Never _____ such a beautiful sunset.
options: I saw
have I seen
I have seen
did I saw
questions.explanation: 考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 have I seen。句意:我从未见过这么美的日落。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Hardly we started when it began to rain.
Hardly had we started when it began to rain.
Hardly we had started when it began to rain.
Hardly did we start when it began to rain.
questions.explanation: Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Hardly had we started when it began to rain.

questions.prompt: 「他不仅工作努力,还很善良。」的正确英文是?
options: Not only works he hard, but he is also kind.
Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.
Not only he does work hard, but he is also kind.
Not only he works hard, but he is also kind.
questions.explanation: 考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Not only does he work hard, but he is also kind.

questions.prompt: Little _____ that the answer was wrong.
options: knew she
she did know
did she know
she knew
questions.explanation: 考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 did she know。句意:她一点也不知道答案是错的。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Not once has he been late this year.
Not once did he was late this year.
Not once he was late this year.
Not once he has been late this year.
questions.explanation: Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Not once has he been late this year.

questions.prompt: 「我们现在很少见到这么老的建筑了。」的正确英文是?
options: Seldom we see such old buildings now.
Seldom see we such old buildings now.
Seldom do we see such old buildings now.
Seldom we do see such old buildings now.
questions.explanation: 考查Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Seldom do we see such old buildings now.

title: only + adverbial inversion · 要点精讲(第2轮)
summary: When only + adverbial (time/condition) is fronted, partial inversion is used; only modifying the subject does not invert.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。
points: Only then did I understand.
Only in this way can we solve it.
Only when the rain stopped did we go out.
only modifying the subject does not invert: Only Tom knows.
the inversion occurs in the clause after only

examples.en: Only then did I understand his words.
examples.zh: 直到那时我才明白他的话。

examples.en: Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
examples.zh: 只有这样我们才能按时完成工作。

examples.en: Only when the teacher came did they stop talking.
examples.zh: 直到老师来了他们才停止交谈。

examples.en: Only at night does the city become quiet.
examples.zh: 只有到了夜里这座城市才安静下来。

examples.en: Only after the meeting did he call me.
examples.zh: 直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。

examples.en: Only with your help can I pass the exam.
examples.zh: 只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Only then understood I his words.
Only then I did understand his words.
Only then I understood his words.
Only then did I understand his words.
questions.explanation: Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only then did I understand his words.

questions.prompt: 「只有这样我们才能按时完成工作。」的正确英文是?
options: Only in this way we finish can the work on time.
Only in this way we can finish the work on time.
Only in this way can we finish the work on time.
Only in this way finish we can the work on time.
questions.explanation: 考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only in this way can we finish the work on time.

questions.prompt: Only when the teacher came _____ talking.
options: stopped they
did they stop
they stopped
they did stop
questions.explanation: 考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 did they stop。句意:直到老师来了他们才停止交谈。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Only at night the city becomes quiet.
Only at night does the city become quiet.
Only at night the city does become quiet.
Only at night becomes the city quiet.
questions.explanation: Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only at night does the city become quiet.

questions.prompt: 「直到会议结束后他才给我打电话。」的正确英文是?
options: Only after the meeting did he call me.
Only after the meeting called he me.
Only after the meeting he called me.
Only after the meeting he did call me.
questions.explanation: 考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。正确句:Only after the meeting did he call me.

questions.prompt: Only with your help _____ the exam.
options: pass I can
I pass can
can I pass
I can pass
questions.explanation: 考查Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。此处应为 can I pass。句意:只有靠你的帮助我才能通过考试。

title: so / neither partial inversion · 要点精讲(第2轮)
summary: so/neither indicates 'the same is true (not)' and takes partial inversion, avoiding repetition.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。
points: So do I = I do too
Neither do I = I don't either
the auxiliary matches the previous sentence
So + subject + auxiliary means indeed so (no inversion)
the tense agrees with the previous sentence

examples.en: I like traveling, and so does my sister.
examples.zh: 我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。

examples.en: He can't drive, and neither can I.
examples.zh: 他不会开车,我也不会。

examples.en: They went to the museum, and so did we.
examples.zh: 他们去了博物馆,我们也去了。

examples.en: I have never been to London, and neither has he.
examples.zh: 我没去过伦敦,他也没去过。

examples.en: She is a nurse, and so am I.
examples.zh: 她是护士,我也是。

examples.en: You won't give up, and neither shall we.
examples.zh: 你们不会放弃,我们也不会。

questions.prompt: 「我喜欢旅行,我妹妹也是。」的正确英文是?
options: I like traveling, and so is my sister.
I like traveling, and so do my sister.
I like traveling, and does so my sister.
I like traveling, and so does my sister.
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:I like traveling, and so does my sister.

questions.prompt: He can't drive, and _____ I.
options: neither can't
neither can
neither do
can neither
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 neither can。句意:他不会开车,我也不会。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: They went to the museum, and so did we.
They went to the museum, and did so we.
They went to the museum, and so were we.
They went to the museum, and so do we.
questions.explanation: so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:They went to the museum, and so did we.

questions.prompt: 「我没去过伦敦,他也没去过。」的正确英文是?
options: I have never been to London, and has neither he.
I have never been to London, and neither haven't he.
I have never been to London, and neither has he.
I have never been to London, and neither does he.
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:I have never been to London, and neither has he.

questions.prompt: She is a nurse, and _____ I.
options: so do
so am
so is
am so
questions.explanation: 考查so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。此处应为 so am。句意:她是护士,我也是。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: You won't give up, and neither do we.
You won't give up, and neither will not we.
You won't give up, and neither shall we.
You won't give up, and shall neither we.
questions.explanation: so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。正确句:You won't give up, and neither shall we.

title: Cleft sentences It is...that · 要点精讲(第2轮)
summary: Cleft sentences emphasize the subject, object or adverbial: It is...that/who..., the tense stays unchanged.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。
points: emphasizing a person: It is...who...
emphasizing a time/place adverbial: It was...that...
not the predicate can be emphasized
the cleft sentence does not change the sentence's meaning
distinguished from the formal subject It is...that

examples.en: It was Tom who broke the window.
examples.zh: 是汤姆打破了窗户。

examples.en: It is English that we practice every morning.
examples.zh: 我们每天早上练的是英语。

examples.en: It was in January that they first met.
examples.zh: 他们是在一月初次见面的。

examples.en: It is my mother who cooks for us every day.
examples.zh: 每天给我们做饭的是我妈妈。

examples.en: It was at the station that I lost my bag.
examples.zh: 我是在车站丢的包。

examples.en: It is hard work that leads to success.
examples.zh: 是努力通向成功。

questions.prompt: It was Tom _____ broke the window.
options: whom
who
which
that whom
questions.explanation: 考查It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。此处应为 who。句意:是汤姆打破了窗户。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: It is English that we practice every morning.
It is English which we practice every morning.
It is English what we practice every morning.
It is English who we practice every morning.
questions.explanation: It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。正确句:It is English that we practice every morning.

questions.prompt: 「他们是在一月初次见面的。」的正确英文是?
options: It was in January what they first met.
It was in January that they first met.
It was in January which they first met.

title: Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Subjunctive mood contrary to present fact: the if clause uses the past, the main clause uses would/could/might + base verb.本课为典型例句练习,核心:If + subject + past form, main clause would + base verb。

title: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: Subjunctive mood contrary to past fact: the if clause uses the past perfect, the main clause uses would have + past participle.本课为典型例句练习,核心:If + had + past participle, main clause would have + past participle。

title: Subjunctive mood after wish · 典型例句(第2轮)
summary: The object clause after wish uses the subjunctive mood: past expresses a present wish, past perfect expresses past regret.本课为典型例句练习,核心:wish + past = a present wish; wish + past perfect = a past regret。

title: Formal subject it · 典型例句(第2轮)

title: Inversion with fronted negative words · 情景运用(第2轮)
summary: Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。
points: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.
Not only did we lose, but we also got hurt.
Little did he know the truth.
the negative adverb determines the use of the auxiliary
